verdict: Greenhouse: Choose Greenhouse when structured hiring is the job and you will take a custom ATS quote — not when you need a free SMB ATS, a core HRIS, or payroll. Scores use the HR editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Deep interview kits, scorecards, and scheduling
Published AI (notetaker, Voice AI, Real Talent) with governance story
weaknesses: Custom quote only — no published seat dollars
Not an HRIS or payroll system
Heavier process than SMB ATS tools
bestFor: Mid-market and enterprise teams that want structured hiring (kits, scorecards, governance)
Talent orgs comparing Greenhouse as the default dedicated ATS
Companies that will integrate ATS to an existing HRIS/payroll rather than buying all-in-one HR
notIdealFor: SMB teams that need a free ATS tier (Breezy Bootstrap)
Buyers whose primary job is core HRIS or payroll
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid depth for ATS, WFM, time, or training jobs
Hub / multi-module pricing complexity vs single-product floors
Mobile/frontline readiness vs desk-bound admin depth
Opaque contact-sales pricing vs transparent published seats
recommendation: Choose Greenhouse when structured hiring is the job and you will take a custom ATS quote — not when you need a free SMB ATS, a core HRIS, or payroll. Compare Breezy HR for transparent SMB ATS pricing, Workable for published ATS floors with light HR, Ashby/Lever as ATS peers, and BambooHR if the real job is core HRIS.
editorialNotes: HR Priority-1 batch. Approved on hr-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=ats-recruiting. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Structured hiring is powerful and process-heavy versus SMB ATS tools. Score reflects mid-market/enterprise ATS admin overhead, not lab testing.
Primary job is ATS/recruiting — Greenhouse is the category-standard structured-hiring shortlist name. Scored inside ATS peers only.
Interview kits, scorecards, scheduling, CRM, and offer/onboarding workflows are deep. Held at 9 vs the most customized enterprise TA suites.
Hundreds of pre-built HRIS, LinkedIn, scheduling, background-check, and Slack connectors plus BI/API on higher tiers.
Recruiter/hiring-manager mobility exists; this is not deskless WFM. Scored for recruiting mobility only.
Recruiting analytics and AI report filters are a published strength on Plus+ packaging.
Core → Plus → Pro plus volume-based quotes support mid-market through enterprise hiring orgs.
Opaque custom quotes and implementation extras depress value versus transparent ATS floors (Breezy/Workable). Affiliate economics excluded.
AI Notetaker, suggestions, Voice AI, and governed MCP are marketed with tier gates — strong ATS AI story, not unlimited included AI.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS, core HRIS, payroll/benefits, people-platform, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
